messages:
Sara (docs): opened a docs PR for on-prem installer: conntrack compatibility & iptables/nftables notes. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4920. Requesting quick validation for the commands and a small preflight checklist.
Priya (eng-ml): skimmed. Good call to mention nf_conntrack_max and conntrack helpers. We should add the sysctl example and a note about conntrack table size for high-throughput inference.
Sara (docs): added a sysctl example and a short paragraph recommending 262144 for heavy workloads. snippet:```bash
# increase conntrack table size
echo 262144 > /proc/sys/net/netfilter/nf_conntrack_max
# persist via /etc/sysctl.d/99-redwood.conf
```
Kevin (eng-infra): Tested installer on an ubuntu box with nftables enabled. Two suggestions: 1) include iptables-nft compat warning (some distros have iptables-legacy by default), 2) provide a small iptables-restore example to fallback if needed. Example iptables-restore:```bash
*filter
:INPUT ACCEPT [0:0]
-A INPUT -p tcp -m tcp --dport 17990 -s 10.0.1.0/24 -m conntrack --ctstate NEW,ESTABLISHED -j ACCEPT
-A INPUT -m conntrack --ctstate ESTABLISHED,RELATED -j ACCEPT
COMMIT
```
Priya (eng-ml): Also add the nftables rule equivalent for customers who disabled iptables-compat:```bash
nft add table inet redwood
nft add chain inet redwood input { type filter hook input priority 0; }
nft add rule inet redwood input ip saddr 10.0.1.0/24 tcp dport 17990 ct state new,established accept
nft add rule inet redwood input ct state established,related accept
```
Omar (security): Important: HSM/KMS endpoints MUST be locked to the management subnet and use mTLS where possible. Add a short socat check to verify TLS and mutual auth:```bash
# test TLS handshake and certificate subject
socat - OPENSSL:kms.internal.local:8443,verify=1,cert=/tmp/client.pem,key=/tmp/client.key,cafile=/tmp/ca.pem
```
Omar (security): Also call out file perms for PKCS#11 sockets and the risk of exposing keys if world-readable. Recommend 0600 for any key files and sockets.
docs-lint-bot: 1 warning: code block line length > 120. Suggest wrapping or using fold markers.
Sara (docs): updated style, wrapped long lines. I also added a short troubleshooting subsection: "installer hangs on module load" — suggestion to check nftables/iptables compatibility and run `update-alternatives --config iptables` on debian/ubuntu.
Kevin (eng-infra): Minor: mention older on-prem CI images use kernel 4.19 and need nf_tables backport; added a short kernel note in troubleshooting.
qa-bot: I'll run automated doc-tests tomorrow against the staging installer and report back.
Priya (eng-ml): can we also include a tiny benchmark note: conntrack sizing impacts sustained concurrent connections (approx 1 conn per session). I'll add an inline note.
Sara (docs): done. Please review PR and add +1 or request changes. pinging @eng-infra, @security, @qa. Preview build: https://docs-preview.redwood.ai/pr-4920/ :white_check_mark:
Kevin (eng-infra): Approved from infra side, left 2 nits inline.
Omar (security): Approved from security after small wording tweak.
Sara (docs): Thanks — merging once CI green and qa-bot posts results.
qa-bot: post results: staging run OK, no installer hangs observed with updated preflight steps.
